proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Paid Advertising
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Tesla to spend at least $50 per car produced on advertising to increase brand and product awareness and mitigate misinformation.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding paid advertising.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Simple Majority Voting Provisions in Governing Documents
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board eliminate supermajority voting requirements in the charter and bylaws, replacing them with a simple majority standard.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding simple majority voting.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Reporting on Employee Arbitration
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the impact of mandatory employee arbitration on harassment, discrimination and employees' ability to seek redress.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding reporting on employee arbitration.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Additional Reporting on Human Rights
proposals.proponent: Sisters of the Good Shepherd New York Province
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on Tesla's processes for embedding respect for human rights within operations and business relationships.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding additional reporting on human rights.
